headline: Weathered Expanse Reignites as Mooring County Heats
war_summary: Since the morning edition the weight of action has shifted to Weathered Expanse, which counts five changes in the last two hours and forty-one on the day about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance to the filing minute, standing four Warden to five Colonial with day losses near fourteen thousand Colonial and seventeen thousand Warden and rates quickening sharply. Mooring County has quickened alongside with three changes in two hours and twenty-two on the day about the Wind Hills and Wiccwalk, holding eleven Warden to one Colonial with losses above five thousand Colonial and four thousand Warden. Fisherman's Row has eased to two changes in two hours, though fifty-two on the day about Eidolo, Black Well and Arcadia keep it active at two Warden to six Colonial with one destroyed. Godcrofts shows two fresh changes about Argosa and Lipsia. Stlican Shelf, Farranac Coast and Linn Mercy have gone quiet in the last two hours, last heard near half past nine, ten past nine and ten past eight, while Callahan's Passage reports no fresh flip despite day losses above ten thousand Colonial and eight thousand Warden.
